title: Identity and access management recommendations
summary: Section-level reference to the identity and access management recommendations of the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark, which cover administrative accounts, multi-factor authentication, guest access and related tenant configuration.
note: The benchmark name and the current version (Microsoft Azure Foundations 6.0.0) were verified via cisecurity.org on 2026-09-10, but the benchmark PDF requires registration and the section numbering used by the rule pack (1.x) could not be confirmed for that version; recommendation text is not reproduced because CIS Benchmarks are licensed under CC BY-NC-SA.
